claims.quote: There  will  be  no  war  in  the  future,
claims.description: Modern weapons make war between great powers impossible without self-destruction.
No decisive victory can be won in a future great war.

claims.quote: It  will  be  a  great  war  of  entrenchments.
claims.description: The next major war will be fought from trenches.
Future battles will last days without decisive result.

claims.quote: the next  war  will  be  a  long  war.
claims.description: The next war will be long, lasting years.

claims.quote: it  will  be  terminated  by famine
claims.description: The war of the future will end by famine rather than battle.

claims.quote: There  will  be  practically  no  care  for  the  wounded,
claims.description: Wounded soldiers will be left on the battlefield without medical care.

claims.quote: In  a  war  between  the  Triple and  the  Dual  Alliance  there  would  be  ten  millions  of  men under  arms.
claims.description: A European war would mobilize ten million soldiers.

claims.quote: Neither  is any  war  possible,  as  I  proceed  to  show,  that  will  not  entail, even  upon  the  victorious  Power,  the  destruction  of  its resources  and  the  break-up  of  society.
claims.description: Any future war would destroy even the victor's economy and society.

claims.quote: It  is  much  more  probable  that  in  the  future  both  sides will  claim  the  victory.
claims.description: Future wars will end inconclusively with both sides claiming victory.

claims.quote: Hence,  under  modern  conditions  of  warfare  every  army will  tend  inevitably  to  degenerate  into  such  a  mob.
claims.description: Armies deprived of officers will collapse into mobs.

claims.quote: the  artillery  duel  will  commence  at  a range  of  from  four  to  five  miles.
claims.description: Future battles open with long-range artillery duels.
